# Auxio-MM4 contribution guidelines

## Crashes & Bugs
Log them in the *HERE*, in the Issues tab. ***DO NOT LOG ISSUES UPSTREAM***

Please keep in mind when reporting an issue:
- **Has it been reported?** Make sure an issue for the issue is not already there.
- **Has it been already fixed?** Sometimes issues are already fixed upstream, or will be fixed soon.
- AGAIN, DO NOT LOG ISSUES UPSTREAM

If you do make an issue, make sure to provide:
- A description of the bug/crash
- A summary of the steps to create the bug/crash
- A stack trace/logcat if possible, the longer the better.

If you have knowledge of Android/Kotlin, or if you have access to an LLM & *know how to use it*, you could also go about fixing the bug yourself & open a PR in the Pull Requests tab.

## Feature Requests
These should also be logged in the Issues tab for *this* project, *not* upstream.

Please keep in mind when requesting a feature:
- **Has it already been requested?** Make sure request for this feature is not already here.
- **Has it been already added?** Make sure this feature has not already been added in the most recent release.
- **Will it be accepted?** Prolly. Like it says in the README, I tend to accept features as long as they won't overbloat the project or go outside of its scope. For example, this project will never support other desktop music library applications, because that's outside its scope. I'm also much more lenient about accepting features than upstream Auxio.

If you do make a request, provide the following:
- What is it that you want?
- Is it related to some problem? If so, describe why.
- Why do you think it will benefit my or your usage of the app?

If you have the knowledge of Android/Kotlin or access to an LLM & *know how to use it*, you can also implement the feature yourself and create a PR in the Pull Request tab, but its recommended that **you create an issue beforehand to give me a heads up.**
Its also recommended that you read about [Auxio's Architecture](https://github.com/OxygenCobalt/Auxio/wiki/Architecture) as well to make changes better and more efficient.

## Translations
Go to (upstream) Auxio's weblate project [here](https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/auxio/). DO NOT request translations of strings that are particular to this project. Instead, create an Issue.

## Contributors & Donations
I don't generally accept additional contributors or donations. I prolly should accept donations since I'm almost homeless, but this is a hobby project just for me & I don't think anyone would donate anyway. This project is very particular to my vision, & I want to learn how to contribute to it & maintain it by myself. If you think you could help me learn that, then I would gladly accept help. Otherwise, feel free to request a feature or make a PR if there's something you want to see in this app.
